item.title: github: CodeQL 2.26.4 improves GitHub actions security detections
item.description:
CodeQL 2.26.4 is a new release that adds support for Go 1.27 and improves GitHub Actions security detections. It is part of the static analysis engine used by GitHub code scanning.

  • Source: GitHub
